svg.text: How a half reads its keys
One 74HC165 per key module. Its byte shifts toward the MCU module on DATA.
/PL loads every 165 at once. Each CLK then shifts every byte one bit toward the MCU module.
DATA as the MCU module reads it: nearest key module first, bit 7 first
Bit 7 is input H, tied to GND, so a key module's byte always has bit 7 clear. E to A are SW5 to SW1.
A byte with bit 7 set ends the chain. Behind the last key module, DATA reads +3.3V, so that byte is 0xFF.
The sentinel's index is the key module count.
